ideas.question: Is there a difference in the incidence of SUID between infants whose mothers experienced prenatal stress and those who did not?
ideas.comparison: SUID cases compared with other causes of infant death within ncfrp_v51, using prams_p7_arf for exposure prevalence.
ideas.why_open: The role of maternal stress on SUID risk is not well understood. An answer could inform preventive interventions aimed at reducing stress during pregnancy.
ideas.data: For each case, use ncfrp_v51 to identify the cause of death and determine if it was SUID. For exposure, match maternal stressors (ncfrp_v51:D100) with prenatal stress measures from prams_p7_arf (D324).

ideas.question: Does hospitalization for newborn complications before the first birthday correlate with an increased risk of SUID?
ideas.comparison: SUID cases compared with non-SUID infant deaths within ncfrp_v51, using prams_p8_arf for hospital stay length.
ideas.why_open: The impact of early-life medical issues on later SUID risk has not been thoroughly investigated. This could reveal critical periods requiring intervention.
ideas.data: Identify cases of SUID and other causes in ncfrp_v51 (D49) by cause of death. Use prams_p8_arf to determine if hospitalization occurred within the first year for any reason (D279).

ideas.question: Do infants from families with preconception health issues exhibit higher SUID incidence compared to those without?
ideas.comparison: SUID cases compared with non-SUID infant deaths within ncfrp_v51, using prams_p8_arf for family preconception care.
ideas.why_open: This relationship is underexplored but could provide insights into long-term health effects of early-stage maternal and family well-being on infants' survival rates.
ideas.data: For SUID cases, use ncfrp_v51 to determine the cause of death and if it was a non-SUID case. Use prams_p8_arf to identify families with preconception health issues (D270).

ideas.question: Is there an increased risk of SUID in infants whose mothers did not receive adequate prenatal care compared to those who received adequate care?
ideas.comparison: SUID cases compared with non-SUID infant deaths within ncfrp_v51, using prams_p8_arf for prenatal healthcare visits.
ideas.why_open: Understanding the importance of timely and sufficient prenatal care could improve public health policies aimed at reducing SUID risk through targeted prenatal interventions.
ideas.data: Use ncfrp_v51 to identify SUID cases and other deaths (D49). Utilize prams_p8_arf to assess prenatal care adequacy via healthcare visit records (D272).

ideas.question: Does inadequate postpartum health care access contribute to higher rates of SUID in infants?
ideas.comparison: SUID cases compared with non-SUID infant deaths within ncfrp_v51, using prams_p8_arf for postpartum healthcare visits.
ideas.why_open: Postnatal support is critical but understudied in relation to SUID. Investigating this could enhance targeted interventions and services during the postpartum period.
ideas.data: Use ncfrp_v51 to identify SUID cases and other infant deaths (D49). Use prams_p8_arf to assess postpartum healthcare access (D283) for exposure comparison.
